subject: Exception conditions
notes: Rule: §14.6.13.1.5 1) (cite.py --check 14.6.13.1.5 "The predefined object reference EXCEPTION-OBJECT is set to the content of the object reference specified in the RAISE statement" -> OK 1)). Both halves located: RAISE identifier-1 -> EmitRaiseObject emits ExceptionState.SetObject(<operand>) before the F4 dispatch; EXIT/GOBACK RAISING identifier-1 -> the callee stages via SetPropagatingObject and the activator's pickup (EmitPropagationPickup) calls SetObject(__po) before dispatching (§14.9.18.4 GR1b2). Golden l1_exit_raising_object_sending (EXIT PROGRAM RAISING W-E, activator F4 declarative SETs U TO EXCEPTION-OBJECT -> 'OBJECT-SENT') pins the EXIT half with a spec-quoting header; golden 2002/oo_ec_raise_object pins the RAISE half ('REGISTER-SET'). || editions as adjudicated: 2002, 2014, 2023 (exception objects arrive with the ISO 2002 OO facility and EC model)
